entries.title: A crewmate on Claude carries on after Infinitary restarts while its background work runs
entries.body: When you quit or restart Infinitary while a crewmate on Claude waits on work it started in the background, such as a test run, the crewmate is now told once that the work did not finish, and picks the task up again. The same holds on a computer that runs work for you, and whenever Claude stops that work on its own. Before, the crewmate could wait for a result that would never come.
entries.noPicture: Nothing new appears on screen: the task moves on after the restart instead of waiting.
